name: LLM root translations
license_verified_from: User decision, D1b handoff (2026-10-18): treated as a derivative of Wiktionary-derived text.
attribution: Root-translation links machine-generated by Google Gemini from Wiktionary-derived text, validated against the database before use.
notes: MACHINE-GENERATED, never curated evidence. Google Gemini (model from ROOT_LLM_MODEL, default gemini-flash-lite-latest; the served model version is recorded per attempt in root_llm_attempts) proposes target-language words for an English sense from its lemma, part of speech and gloss. A proposal is admitted only if normalize_lemma resolves it to a lexeme in the target language with a viable display sense (app/services/root_llm.py::_resolve_one_language, via root_selection._display_sense_scored); admitted links are stored as sense_translations rows with attachment 'llm'. Query-time generation is off in production (ROOT_LLM_QUERY_TIME=0); links created earlier are stored in the reference data and read by the llm root rung.
